tels.about.heading: About TELS
tels.about.p1: TELS — TitanEd Learning Services — is TitanEd’s professional and lifelong learning platform. We partner with academic and industry organizations to deliver rigorous, accessible courses across programming, business, data science, humanities, and more.
tels.about.p2: Our courses are built on modern open infrastructure and designed for working professionals who want to grow their craft, teachers who want to improve their practice, and lifelong learners who want to keep learning.
tels.about.p3: TitanEd is headquartered in Gurugram, India, and works with partners around the world.

tels.legal.a11y.title: Accessibility
tels.legal.a11y.intro: TitanEd is committed to making TELS usable by learners of all abilities. This statement describes our accessibility goals and how to get help.
tels.legal.a11y.seeAlso: See also our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink> and <termsLink>Terms of Use</termsLink>.
tels.legal.a11y.commitment.title: 1. Our Commitment
tels.legal.a11y.commitment.body: We aim to make TELS experiences accessible to learners who use assistive technology, and we design toward WCAG 2.1 Level AA as a practical target for public marketing and course surfaces.
tels.legal.a11y.standards.title: 2. Standards We Follow
tels.legal.a11y.standards.body: Our product and design practices reference WCAG 2.1 and related Open edX accessibility guidance. Formal conformance documentation (such as a VPAT) may be available on request for enterprise partners.
tels.legal.a11y.features.title: 3. Accessibility Features
tels.legal.a11y.features.body: TELS supports keyboard navigation, meaningful labels for interactive controls, skip-to-content links on public pages, screen-reader-friendly structure, and alt text on course imagery where images convey meaning.
tels.legal.a11y.courseContent.title: 4. Course Content Accessibility
tels.legal.a11y.courseContent.body: Partner schools and instructors are expected to provide accessible materials where feasible, including captions or transcripts for video, structured documents, and readable contrast. Contact us if you need an alternative format for a specific course.
tels.legal.a11y.thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Tools
tels.legal.a11y.thirdParty.body: Some embedded or linked third-party tools are outside TitanEd’s direct control. We review vendors for accessibility where practical and document known limitations when we become aware of them.
tels.legal.a11y.assistive.title: 6. Compatibility with Assistive Technology
tels.legal.a11y.assistive.body: We test primary flows in current versions of major browsers with common assistive technologies such as screen readers and keyboard-only navigation. Results may vary by device, browser, and AT combination.
tels.legal.a11y.known.title: 7. Known Issues
tels.legal.a11y.known.body: We continuously improve accessibility. If you encounter a barrier, please report it so we can prioritize a fix. Temporary workarounds may be offered while remediation is underway.
tels.legal.a11y.feedback.title: 8. Feedback and Assistance
tels.legal.a11y.feedback.body: Learners who encounter an accessibility barrier can request assistance or accessible course materials through our contact channels. We aim to acknowledge requests promptly and provide a reasonable accommodation where feasible.
tels.legal.a11y.training.title: 9. Ongoing Training
tels.legal.a11y.training.body: TitanEd teams and partner contributors are encouraged to follow accessibility checklists during design and content authoring so accessibility is maintained as features evolve.
tels.legal.a11y.changes.title: 10. Changes to this Statement
tels.legal.a11y.changes.body: We may update this accessibility statement as our practices improve. Changes are reflected by revising the “Last updated” date on this page.
tels.legal.a11y.contact.title: 11. Contact
tels.legal.a11y.contact.body: For accessibility questions or to request accommodations, contact us at Legal@TitanEd.com or via titaned.com.
tels.legal.eea.docTitle: EEA Privacy Disclosures — TELS by TitanEd
tels.legal.eea.title: EEA Privacy Disclosures
tels.legal.eea.intro: These disclosures supplement our Privacy Policy with information for individuals in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, and Switzerland.
tels.legal.eea.scope.title: 1. Who this Applies To
tels.legal.eea.scope.body: This page applies to individuals located in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland whose personal data is processed in connection with TELS under GDPR or UK GDPR.
tels.legal.eea.controller.title: 2. Data Controller and Representative
tels.legal.eea.controller.body: TitanEd is the data controller for personal data processed through TELS unless a partner institution is identified as controller for a specific course. Contact details for privacy requests are listed below.
tels.legal.eea.legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Bases for Processing
tels.legal.eea.legalBasis.body: We rely on legal bases including performance of a contract (delivering courses and accounts), legitimate interests (improving and securing the platform), consent (where required for marketing or optional cookies), and legal obligation.
tels.legal.eea.categories.title: 4. Categories of Personal Data
tels.legal.eea.categories.body: Categories may include identity and contact data, account credentials, enrollment and learning activity, payment metadata, technical logs, and communications you send to us. Data may come from you directly, from your use of the service, or from identity providers you choose.
tels.legal.eea.transfers.title: 5. International Data Transfers
tels.legal.eea.transfers.body: When personal data is transferred outside the EEA/UK, we use appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses or an applicable adequacy decision. You may request more information about these safeguards by contacting us.
tels.legal.eea.retention.title: 6. Retention
tels.legal.eea.retention.body: We retain EEA/UK personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in the Privacy Policy and these disclosures, including legal, accounting, and security requirements.
tels.legal.eea.rights.title: 7. Your Rights under GDPR / UK GDPR
tels.legal.eea.rights.body: You may have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection, and rights related to automated decision-making where applicable. To exercise a right, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding.
tels.legal.eea.complaints.title: 8. Right to Lodge a Complaint
tels.legal.eea.complaints.body: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your country of residence, place of work, or the place of an alleged infringement. We encourage you to contact us first so we can try to resolve your concern.
tels.legal.eea.dpo.title: 9. Data Protection Contact
tels.legal.eea.dpo.body: Privacy and data-protection requests for EEA/UK individuals may be sent to Legal@TitanEd.com. Please include enough detail for us to identify your account and request.
tels.legal.eea.changes.title: 10. Changes to these Disclosures
tels.legal.eea.changes.body: We may update these disclosures as our practices or legal requirements change. Updates are noted by revising the “Last updated” date on this page.
tels.legal.eea.contact.title: 11. Contact
tels.legal.eea.contact.body: For EEA/UK privacy questions, contact us at Legal@TitanEd.com or via titaned.com.
tels.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
tels.legal.privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how TitanEd collects, uses, and shares information when you use TELS websites, courses, and related services.
tels.legal.privacy.scope.title: 1. Scope of this Statement
tels.legal.privacy.scope.body: This statement covers the TELS marketing site, course catalog, learner accounts, course platform experiences, and related marketing emails operated by TitanEd. TitanEd is the data controller for personal data processed through these services unless a partner institution is identified as controller for a specific offering.
tels.legal.privacy.collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
tels.legal.privacy.collect.body: We may collect account details, enrollment and progress activity, payment metadata, device and usage data, cookies and similar technologies, and information provided through forms or third-party sign-in providers.
tels.legal.privacy.use.title: 3. How We Use Information
tels.legal.privacy.use.body: We use information to deliver courses, personalize recommendations, process payments, send service messages, improve the platform, secure accounts, and comply with legal obligations.
tels.legal.privacy.legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Bases for Processing
tels.legal.privacy.legalBasis.body: Where GDPR, UK GDPR, or similar frameworks apply, we process personal data under one or more legal bases such as performance of a contract, consent, legitimate interests, and legal obligation. Additional EEA/UK details appear on our EEA Privacy Disclosures page when published.
tels.legal.privacy.share.title: 5. When We Share Information
tels.legal.privacy.share.body: We share information with service providers who help operate TELS (hosting, payment processing, analytics), with partner institutions that issue certificates or co-offer courses, and when required by law or to protect rights and safety. Recipients are required to protect data consistent with this policy.
tels.legal.privacy.cookies.title: 6. Cookies and Similar Technologies
tels.legal.privacy.cookies.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to run the site and may use analytics or marketing cookies where permitted. You can manage browser cookie settings; disabling some cookies may limit functionality.
tels.legal.privacy.retention.title: 7. Data Retention
tels.legal.privacy.retention.body: We retain personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, including account administration, course records, legal compliance, and dispute resolution. Retention periods vary by data category.
tels.legal.privacy.rights.title: 8. Your Rights
tels.legal.privacy.rights.body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, port, object to, or restrict processing of your personal data, and to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. Contact us to exercise these rights.
tels.legal.privacy.children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
tels.legal.privacy.children.body: TELS is intended for adult learners and is not directed at children under 16 (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided information, contact us so we can delete it.
tels.legal.privacy.transfers.title: 10. International Transfers
tels.legal.privacy.transfers.body: TitanEd and its providers may process data in countries other than your own. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or adequacy decisions for cross-border transfers.
tels.legal.privacy.security.title: 11. Security
tels.legal.privacy.security.body: We use organizational and technical measures designed to protect personal information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; please use a strong unique password and notify us of suspected unauthorized access.
tels.legal.privacy.changes.title: 12. Changes to this Statement
tels.legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by revising the “Last updated” date on this page. Continued use of TELS after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy where permitted by law.
tels.legal.privacy.contact.title: 13. Contact
tels.legal.privacy.contact.body: For privacy questions, contact us at Legal@TitanEd.com or via titaned.com.
tels.legal.terms.docTitle: Terms of Use — TELS by TitanEd
tels.legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
tels.legal.terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to TELS websites and courses operated by TitanEd. By using TELS, you agree to these terms.
tels.legal.terms.acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of these Terms
tels.legal.terms.acceptance.body: By accessing or using TELS websites and courses, you agree to these Terms of Use. We may update these terms from time to time and will post the revised version on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
tels.legal.terms.eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility and Accounts
tels.legal.terms.eligibility.body: You must be able to form a binding contract under applicable law to create an account. You agree to provide accurate registration information, keep your credentials secure, and notify us promptly of unauthorized use. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms or applicable law.
tels.legal.terms.content.title: 3. Course Content and Licenses
tels.legal.terms.content.body: Course materials and platform content remain the property of TitanEd, partner institutions, or their licensors. We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license for personal learning use. Redistribution, scraping, resale, or public display of materials without written permission is prohibited.
tels.legal.terms.conduct.title: 4. Acceptable Use
tels.legal.terms.conduct.body: You agree to participate respectfully in discussions and course activities. Harassment, cheating, unauthorized sharing of assessments, or any activity that disrupts the platform or other learners is not allowed and may result in removal from courses or the platform.
tels.legal.terms.payments.title: 5. Payments, Refunds, and Cancellations
tels.legal.terms.payments.body: Prices, taxes, and billing details are shown at checkout. Refund and cancellation windows vary by course offering and are stated at purchase. Where consumer-protection laws require different remedies, those rights apply in addition to these terms.
tels.legal.terms.thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Services
tels.legal.terms.thirdParty.body: TELS may integrate third-party services such as payment processors, video hosts, and analytics providers. Those services are governed by their own terms and privacy policies. We are not responsible for third-party sites or services beyond our control.
tels.legal.terms.ip.title: 7. Intellectual Property
tels.legal.terms.ip.body: TitanEd names, logos, and trademarks may not be used without prior written permission. By submitting content to the platform, you grant TitanEd a license to host and display it as needed to operate the service. Copyright complaints may be sent to Legal@TitanEd.com.
tels.legal.terms.disclaimers.title: 8. Disclaimers
tels.legal.terms.disclaimers.body: TELS is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. We do not warrant uninterrupted availability, error-free operation, or specific learning or employment outcomes. Some jurisdictions do not allow certain disclaimers; in those places, disclaimers apply to the fullest extent permitted by law.
tels.legal.terms.liability.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
tels.legal.terms.liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, TitanEd’s total liability arising from these terms or your use of TELS is limited to the fees you paid for the affected course in the twelve months before the claim. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages where such limitation is allowed.
tels.legal.terms.termination.title: 10. Termination
tels.legal.terms.termination.body: We may suspend or terminate access if you breach these terms or if required for legal or security reasons. Upon termination, your right to access paid content may end except where law requires continued access or a refund.
tels.legal.terms.law.title: 11. Governing Law and Disputes
tels.legal.terms.law.body: These terms are governed by the laws applicable to TitanEd’s principal place of business, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Courts in that venue have exclusive jurisdiction, except where mandatory consumer protections require otherwise.
tels.legal.terms.changes.title: 12. Changes to these Terms
tels.legal.terms.changes.body: We may amend these terms by posting an updated version on this page. Material changes will be noted by revising the “Last updated” date. Your continued use of TELS after the effective date means you accept the updated terms.
tels.legal.terms.contact.title: 13. Contact
tels.legal.terms.contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact us via titaned.com.
